sherpa-onnx.note: Prebuilt sherpa-onnx static XCFramework built by the package's public GitHub Actions workflow from the upstream tag (it compiles against onnxruntime 1.28.2 headers; requests ORT API version 28). `python3 scripts/fetch_sherpa_onnx.py` downloads it into ThirdParty/sherpa-onnx (not committed) and verifies this checksum. The package's own onnxruntime.xcframework.zip (1.24.4, API 24) is NOT used: sherpa-onnx refuses it at engine creation ('requested API version [28] is not available'), verified with Leaf's synthesizer code on the Mac.

onnxruntime.note: The same k2-fsa onnxruntime iOS static XCFramework that sherpa-onnx's build-ios.sh downloads for v1.13.8 (device + simulator slices). Fetched by scripts/fetch_sherpa_onnx.py; not committed.
